title: Measuring Cross-Task Behavioral Consistency in Language Model Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.13598v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent evaluation relies almost entirely on outcome metrics such as success rate, which capture whether an agent succeeds but not how consistently it behaves. We argue that behavioral consistency across tasks is a distinct and measurable property, and we introduce the Behavioral Consistency Metric (BCM) to quantify it. BCM trains a model to predict task success from behavioral features of agent execution traces, derives a per-trajectory feature-attribution vector, and measures the mean pairwise similarity of these vectors within an agent system. Across roughly 9,000 trajectories from six language model agents on software engineering tasks, our central finding is that cross-task and within-task consistency are distinct axes that can diverge: some systems are locally reproducible, behaving similarly on repeated attempts at one task, yet globally fragmented, with no stable strategy across different tasks, while others are consistent at both

translated_title: 语言模型代理中跨任务行为一致性的测量
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13598v1 公告类型：新 摘要：代理评估几乎完全依赖于结果指标，如成功率，这捕捉了代理是否成功，但不捕捉其行为的一致性。我们认为，跨任务的行为一致性是一个独立且可测量的属性，并引入行为一致性度量（BCM）来量化它。BCM训练一个模型，从代理执行轨迹的行为特征预测任务成功，推导每个轨迹的特征归因向量，并测量代理系统内这些向量的平均成对相似性。在软件工程任务中，来自六个语言模型代理的大约9000条轨迹上，我们的核心发现是，跨任务一致性和任务内一致性是可能分化的不同轴：一些系统在局部上是可复现的，在重复尝试同一任务时行为相似，但在全局上是碎片化的，在不同任务间没有稳定策略，而其他系统则在两者上都一致。
tldr: 本文提出了行为一致性度量（BCM），用于量化语言模型代理在跨任务行为中的一致性，并发现跨任务与任务内一致性是独立且可能分化的属性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Behavioral Consistency Metric (BCM) to quantify cross-task behavioral consistency in language model agents, revealing that cross-task and within-task consistency are distinct axes that can diverge.
